spl:
index=environment sourcetype=aranet:sensor sensor_id=* pressure_hpa=*
| sort 0 _time
| streamstats window=6 global=f earliest(pressure_hpa) as p0 latest(pressure_hpa) as p1 by sensor_id
| eval delta_hpa=round(p1-p0,2)
| where abs(delta_hpa) > 2.5
| table _time, sensor_id, location, p0, p1, delta_hpa
| eval abs_delta=abs(delta_hpa)
| sort - abs_delta

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Reference sensor or weather feed optional but strongly recommended.
• Document HVAC economizer cycles that move pressure.

Step 1 — Backtest window on a year of data.

Step 2 — Add `by zone_id` if multiple sensors per room.

Step 3 — Physical security runbook cross-links.

Step 4 — Privacy review if combined with badge data.

Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (MQTT or HEC ingest for Aranet barometric sensors — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=aranet:sensor into environment. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower. Grant the ingestion role `list_inputs` and `search` on the target index.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert

Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages. Document tunable macros in the comment header. Understanding this SPL: filters in the first pipeline reduce license cost; stats/timechart aggregates define the alert grain; joins/lookups enrich owner or asset metadata for routing.

Step 3 — Validate

Compare `| tstats count where index=... sourcetype=...` against the vendor admin UI inventory count (+/-5%). Spot-check two known entities for field presence (`sensor_id`). Run `timechart count span=1h` over 7 days to find ingestion gaps longer than two poll intervals.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Add a dashboard row with single-value KPI tiles, a 24-hour timechart, and a drilldown table mirroring the SPL output columns. Route critical severity to the platform on-call channel; route warning to the service owner from the lookup.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

No events: verify forwarder connectivity, HEC token ACLs, and that the modular input appears in `index=_internal source=*splunkd*`. NULL fields: check props/transforms order and TA version. Fewer results than expected: confirm index allow-lists on the search head role and that `_time` uses the correct timezone. API errors: inspect splunkd.log for HTTP 401/429 from the vendor endpoint configured in inputs.conf.
